Mobs.LongDescription: The little louse hops from giant to giant to dog to ... YOU!
Mobs.Description:
The giants who live here bathe somewhat irregularly and their unwashed
bodies offer a generous home to the lice that inhabit them.  Since the
giants are frequently drunk and the lice feed off of them, the lice are
a pretty laid back group of insects.

Mobs.Description:
Gina and Tina are twins.  It is their job to turn cream from the
contented yaks into ice cream.  They add fresh raspberries and
blueberries - the ones that Razzl and Dazzl collect.  Yummmy!

Mobs.LongDescription: The anxious mother wonder if you have seen her brat son.
Mobs.Description:
As a dwarven mother with a daredevil son, Gloria is a constant nerve
wreck and with those kind of stunt her son pulls, one can not but agree
with her worries. Apart from that she looks like a nice woman with a well

Mobs.Description:
The little boy dances around you like a wild. He even tries to climb
anything close to while doing so. He must be completely out of his mind
or just very persistent in NOT going to bed as his mother would suggest.

Mobs.LongDescription: A little gnome dangles his legs over the edge of the chasm.
Mobs.Description:
The small gnome looks rather old, or old compared to other gnomes at
least, never seen a young gnome come to think about it. Maybe they are
born old. He holds a small pipe in one of his very callous hands. He must
have worked a lot with his hands to achieve that status. Maybe what is

Mobs.Description:
If the ordinary dwarf is stocky compared with human standards he
still would look like a thin thread compared with this hunk of a dwarf.

superiors would be worse. The guards are under strict orders to remove

Mobs.Description:
Well a dwarf is a dwarf is a dwarf is a dwarf is a .... *sigh*
This one is no different than the rest of them, short and stocky with a
big beard worn clearly visible no matter what happens. He glares at you
angrily for walking on his newly clean surrounding.

Mobs.Name: wraith
Mobs.LongDescription: You just can not see the wraith.
Mobs.Description:
A disturbance in the air alerts you to the fact that you are not alone.
It's difficult to describe the feeling, a combination of the microhairs
all over your body springing to alert, the hard hammering of your heart
and a sudden queasiness in your stomach.

Mobs.Name: dwarf dwarven guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven guard is here.
Mobs.Description:
The guard looks very tough and mean. He wears his beard long, and he smells
like he hasn't bathed in over a month.

Mobs.Name: dwarf dwarven worker
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven mining worker is here.
Mobs.Description: He is very dirty, and looks extremely over-worked.

Mobs.Name: wraith
Mobs.LongDescription: A wraith is awaiting your first move here.
Mobs.Description: A black, almost transparent wraith.

Mobs.Name: storekeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: The Hide & Tooth storekeeper is standing here, waiting patiently.
Mobs.Description: The storekeeper is very rotund, but looks in excellent condition.

Mobs.Name: baker
Mobs.LongDescription: Granite Head, the baker, is waiting for a customer here.
Mobs.Description: Granite Head is covered with flour and grains.

Mobs.Name: lizard
Mobs.LongDescription: A giant lizard is foraging for food along the cavern floor here.
Mobs.Description:
This scaly creature looks like it is well adapted to it's underground
habitat.  He looks very powerful.

Mobs.Name: giant
Mobs.LongDescription: A giant is wandering around the mountainside here.
Mobs.Description:
The giant is about 18 feet tall, with arms of steel, and looks in
excellent physical condition.

Mobs.Name: dwarven dwarf miner mineworker worker
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven mineworker is here.
Mobs.Description: The mineworker is very tired, and very dirty, and he has bulging muscles.

Mobs.Name: dwarven mineleader dwarf mine leader
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven mine leader is here, supervising the work.
Mobs.Description:
The mine leader is very big and very strong, though he must be fairly bright
also, to have gotten this job.

Mobs.Name: dwarven healer
Mobs.LongDescription: The dwarven healer is here, aiding the sick of his people.
Mobs.Description: He is a very skilled healer, and extremely faithful to his god.

Mobs.Name: dwarven peon
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven peon is awaiting help here.

Mobs.Name: dwarf
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarf is here.

Objects.Name: boots stomping
Objects.Description: One of these days these boots are gonna STOMP all over you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
*STOMP* is the last sound most small harmless creatures hear
when Stanley's Stompin' Boots come crushing down on them. These boots
are really really big and heavy to fit Stanley's bloated feet.
Stanley likes to *stomp* away on small creatures (the big ones
can strike back, so that isnt any fun) when he gets irritated,
which is quite often.

Objects.Name: spyglass nells
Objects.Description: A long cylinder of brass and glass is actually a spyglass.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Nell's first reaction when using the spyglass was, "Things sure
got big in here". Its a prized possession, given to her by an elf once
in exchange for her help. She never leaves it behind, carrying it
with her in her journeys across the big world, and now using it to find
out what happened to the Lost Gnomes.

Objects.Name: pouch magical nells
Objects.Description: A small leather pouch in #rra#yi#gnb#cow#G colors waits for its owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This magical pouch was "given" (according to Nell) by a dark elf wizard.
When asked about why exactly the wizard gave his magical pouch to the
gnome, Nell sways on the subject and states she wont say another
word without a lawyer.

Objects.Name: stick magic marthas
Objects.Description: A gnarly branch has fallen off of some tree and lies at your feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is Martha's magic stick. If its magical, no-one really knows since
Martha never lets anyone else touch it. It's very gnarly and doesnt look
much different than an ordinary branch from a tree.

Objects.Name: spy badge
Objects.Description: This badge bears the stamp of the Gnomish Spy Organization.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Martha proudly wears this badge around her neck. She's very
proud of being the junior member of the gnomish spy network! Soon
she'll advance in ranks! The GSO motto is engraved on it: Stealthy,
Scrounging, Soda.

Objects.Name: helmet hagbards
Objects.Description: Hagbard's hefty helmet isn't on Hagbard's thick head at the moment.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
After being hit in the head countless times and getting a bruise
despite his standard dwarf helmet, Hagbard went to the magician
Hfloan to help him. This helmet was the result, a sturdy helmet
made of mithril, enhanced with magic. Hagbard didnt pay anything
for it, but he still wonders why his paycheck seems to be a bit
smaller than the rest of the workers...

Objects.Name: chainmail dwarven ordinary
Objects.Description: Ordinary dwarven chainmail is worn by ordinary dwarf fighters.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An ordinary dwarven chainmail, heavy but effective. It has no
ornamental features, but protects from most kind of slashing
and piercing attacks. It is very vulnerable to crushing ones,
however.

Objects.Name: helmet
Objects.Description: Part of a dwarf soldier's uniform has been forgotten.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This helmet is standard issue for dwarven soldiers. Its made
of iron and protects against most kind of rocks falling, but its
defensive qualities against most other weapons are fairly light.

Objects.Name: chainmail goldlined
Objects.Description: Bright gold shines from within the chainmail.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This chainmail resembles an ordinary chainmail, but seems to be more robust
and light. It glimmers slightly, and has golden lining, informing you that
this is an officers chainmail.

Objects.Name: helmet ornamental
Objects.Description: The ornamental helmet is suitable for a Royal Dwarf Body Guard!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small jewel is engraved at the front of this helmet, reflecting the light.
It's not a very valauble jewel, but indicates that the helmet is meant for a
more distinguished dwarf than the common soldier.

Objects.Name: hermann symbol medallion cleric
Objects.Description: A pulsating holy symbol has a life of it's own.  (Do you?)

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Dedicated to Hermann's god, this is the symbol that gives Hermann his healing
powers. It glows gently, pulsating with the faith Hermann has. (It's quite
ugly too, but dont tell Hermann that or he'll club you).

Objects.Name: gold lump nugget
Objects.Description: This gold nugget should be worth a lot at the assayer's office.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Perhaps if you took this to a metallurgist, he might tell you if it was
actually worth anything.  Or perhaps you could simply try to sell it.

Objects.Name: egg
Objects.Description: Which came first?  The chicken or the ... ?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A bright blue, ovoid-shaped, fragile-shelled product of a chicken ... c'mon,
surely you've seen one of these before.  It's nothing special ...

Objects.Name: boots miningboots
Objects.Description: Heavy but very sturdy boots look like good protection for your feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Getting a rock on your toes hurt everybit as much as getting it in your head.
These boots have metal plates attached to them to prevent this issue.  They
are also quite good to keep out the damp.

Objects.Name: gnomish adventuring vest
Objects.Description: You'd think a Lost Adventurer would be easy to find in this vest!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The uniform of a graduate Adventuring Gnome, this vest has a fair number of
pockets that can hold anything interesting the adventurer. It's fairly sturdy,
but not meant for fighting. It also has cool colors! (#ggreen#N/#mpurple#N).

Objects.Name: pipe
Objects.Description: The smoothness of the pipe's surface attests to it's frequent use.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This pipe is used to smoke tobacco, a fairly common practice for hobbits and
halflings. Dwarves have recently started to take a liking to it, as well.

Objects.Name: sceptre
Objects.Description:
A tall golden sceptre looks like it might be a good weapon for a
king.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The mark of office in this dwarf kingdom is this sceptre. It is a heavy
sceptre, with jewels embedded in its shaft. In times of emergency, the king
can use this to fend off any assailants by hitting them in the head with it.

Objects.Name: mask sleeping
Objects.Description: This mask will cover your eyes and help you to sleep.

Objects.Name: weight-lifting belt
Objects.Description: Some off duty guards wear this belt when they are working out.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The guards work out to maintain their bulging muscles, more from hope that
some day another female dwarf will appear than from any real need to guard the
mines.

Objects.Name: casket
Objects.Description: Lady J's casket of precious jewels has been left unattended.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A precious object itself, this small wooden box is inlaid with a beautiful
desing in precious woods and ornamented with a large ruby in the center of the
lid.

Objects.Name: Pin
Objects.Description: A pin must have come loose from a passing member.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This must be a member pin of the Hulio Fan Club. To apply just mail the fan
club or visit your local fan club office. It is rather pretty too.

Objects.Name: yak horn
Objects.Description: The long sharp tip of a yak's horn has been fashioned into a dagger.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The long slender, exceedingly sharp tip of a yak's well-polished horn has been
affixed to an ebony handle.  In the right hands this horn becomes an awesome
weapon.

Objects.Name: comb dwarven beardcomb recall
Objects.Description: A dwarven beardcomb looks slightly grotty but usable.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A dwarven beard is truly a thing of beauty, and must be cared for daily. This
comb has closely placed teeth to comb out nits.

Objects.Name: doll Nelly
Objects.Description: Here is a Nelly doll, complete with long red braids and rainbow cape.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
In honor of the mighty gnome psionicist, Nelly, who is well known the world
over (and especially in cities beginning with the letter "S"), this little
doll became every child's favorite toy.

Objects.Name: cookie oatmeal
Objects.Description: One of Jilly's best cookies has not yet been discovered.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
One of Jilly's favorite cookies to make is this soft, chewy oatmeal cookie,
scented with cinnamon and sweetened with honey and a couple of raisins.

Objects.Name: gold lump nugget
Objects.Description: A very large nugget gleams softly in the dim light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Perhaps if you took this to a metallurgist, he might tell you if it was
actually worth anything.  Or perhaps you could simply try to sell it.

Objects.Name: gold lump nugget
Objects.Description: A very large nugget gleams softly in the dim light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Perhaps if you took this to a metallurgist, he might tell you if it was
actually worth anything.  Or perhaps you could simply try to sell it.

Objects.Name: icecream
Objects.ShortDescription: a bowl of raspberry-blueberry ice cream
Objects.Description: A nice big bowl of raspberry-blueberry ice cream is slowly melting.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The very best ice cream comes from contented yaks and the yaks at this farm
are very content.  Gina and Tina add just the right quantities of sugar and
berries.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka wolf werewolf
Objects.ShortDescription: a pepparkaka cookie shaped like a wolf
Objects.Description: The very small werewolf looks ready to bite you.  Bite it first!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This small gingerbread werewolf is no real threat to you.  It is spicy and
sweet at the same time.  Very tasty!

Objects.Name: pepparkaka cookie gingerbread dragon
Objects.ShortDescription: a pepparkaka cookie shaped like a dragon
Objects.Description: The little dragon looks very hot!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Baked of spicy gingergread then carefully decorated, the little cookie looks
very much like a real dragon ... only smaller!  With those giant wings, it
might just take off and fly, so you'd better bite it quickly.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka gnome
Objects.ShortDescription: a pepparkaka cookie shaped like a gnome
Objects.Description: A little gnome wiggles her gingerbread ears at you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Actually, if you look closely at this little gnome you can see that the Mind-
Bogglingly Magnificent Nell insisted on posing for the gingerbread cookie mold
that this cookie popped out of.  And of course, she is wearing her trademark
rainbow cape.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka elf superelf
Objects.Description:
All little boys, except the Trollish ones, want to be
superheroes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
With the very nicely pointed ears and the magnificent cape, this could be none
other than the Elfking himself.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka angel angelic
Objects.Description: A very angelic-looking cookie flies by on sugar wings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The little gingerbread angel has a #ws#Yp#wa#Yr#wk#Yl#wi#Yn#Wg
#y*halo*#N on its head.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka balloon
Objects.Description: This cookie is lighter than air and might float away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A hot air balloon with a little picnic basket bottom and brightly colored
(iced) silks.  The picnic basket looks large enough for a small troop of
gnomes, complete with picnic!

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka glob
Objects.ShortDescription: a globby mess of a pepparkaka
Objects.Description: A slightly soggy underbaked sunken glob of cookie is still lip smackin!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Apparently this is one of Jilly's few failures and yet, she is very pleased
with this particular cookie.  It is a large, amorphous glob of a cookie, looks
slightly wet and (and I know this is very strange), it radiates an evil aura.
Stamped on the underside (the slightly flatter side) of the cookie you can see
the words in Old Gnomish, "Property of Glob, Inc".

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka viking
Objects.Description: A little dirt on the viking pepparkaka makes him just look more real.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
With its blue sugar crystal eyes and toasty marshmallow hair, this gingerbread
cookie makes your mouth water despite the fact it's managed to roll a bit in
the dirt.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka troll
Objects.Description: The HUGE pepparkaka looks very thick and warty.  Must be trollish!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The features on this HUGE pepparkaka troll are slightly out of proportion, and
someone has put a tiny currant wart on his bulbous nose. He was a bit thicker
than the other cookies, so he may not be baked all the way through.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka fairy
Objects.Description: The fairy pepparkaka has white icing-wings and a licorice wand.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Barely a mouthful of gingerbread makes up this tiny melt-in-your-mouth spicy
sweet cookie.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka viking
Objects.Description: This #wViking#G pepparkaka looks like he has been rolling in the dirt!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Although this pepparkaka #wViking#N looks fierce, he is spicy
and sweet.  Well equipped with candy axe and hammer, the cookie Viking's
pale blond yellow-icing hair streaks out from beneath his conical helmet.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka sunflower
Objects.Description: #ySunflower#G pepparkakor are painted with lemon and chocolate icing.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Apparently the gnomes are fond of sunflowers.  This one has been
carefully decorated to resemble the real sunflowers grown by the
gnomes at the experimental farm.

Objects.Name: sunflower
Objects.Description: The brilliant yellow sunflower radiates heat.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Cut from its roots, this sunflower won't last forever, but while
it does, it radiates warmth and a certain happiness.

Objects.Name: ticket correct papers paper key
Objects.ShortDescription: A piece of very correct paper
Objects.Description: Someone discarded a little ticket without a care of its value.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The papers seems rather unuseful, but then again they can come in
handy at the most unexpected and bizarre occasions.

Objects.Name: ticket correct papers paper key
Objects.ShortDescription: A other side of some very correct paper
Objects.Description: Someone discarded a little ticket facedown without a care of its value.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The papers seems rather unuseful, but then again even this side can
come in handy at the most unexpected and bizarre occasions.

Objects.Name: boots sticky
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of soft but sticky boots
Objects.Description: A pair of soft boots has got stuck to the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The boots is made out of some soft leathery material that would fit
very good on most feet. The binding is made out of long strings that can
be tied firmly around the foot, ankle and leg. What makes then extra
special is that they seem to stick to the ground giving a very good
balance once one get used to it.

Objects.Name: key
Objects.ShortDescription: a key on a long golden chain
Objects.Description: A rusty iron key has been strung on a long golden chain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the sort of key that looks like a small rusty flag.  It's pretty
clear the key hasn't been used in a long time, and probably was lost and
forgotten.

Objects.Name: large heavy key
Objects.Description: A large heavy key has been dropped.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This large, heavy metal key has been marked with the picture of
a gate.

Objects.Name: hammer dwarven
Objects.Description: Sometimes a dwarf's just gotta #WPOUND#G things, ya know?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Crafted by the dwarven smiths, this hammer serves both as a tool
and a weapon. In times of war it can be used to pound away on enemies that
need pounding.  Either way, it is a trusty pounding item. It's not worth many
pounds, but it is dependable and trustworthy.  An insignia on its shaft reads
"MADE BY POUNDING PUN'S INC."

Objects.Name: plate dwarven mail
Objects.Description: Dwarves make all manner of armor.  This is dwarven plate mail.

Objects.Name: stick
Objects.Description: This long black stick is a branch off of a long black tree.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A magic stick off a magic tree, it is trying frantically to mend itself where
it was rudely ripped off by some passing giant.  It is not terribly good at
mending itself, though, and the healing vibrations seem to scatter everywhere
but on itself.  Perhaps if you hold it in your hand and wave it about a bit,
those around you might get better! Or ... not.

Objects.Name: stick
Objects.Description: A long, black stick was pulled from its tree long ago.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This stout stick looks easily combustible.  You could probably
use it as a torch if you lit the end of it.

Objects.Name: dwarven club
Objects.Description: A heavy, smooth, blunt piece of steel-sheathed wood is a dwarven club.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Now, a club sounds like a primitive weapon and, indeed it is, however the
dwarves managed to make this particular version of a club do a LOT of damage,
if you are strong enough to wield it.  Made of a solid hardwood at its core
then covered with a spiky layer of steel over that, this club was the dwarves
first defense against the giants ... before they learned to simply outsmart
them.

#CGiant stares at you, drooling.
You tell Giant, "Me no taste good.  You eat tree!"
Giant beams and wanders off, looking for a tree.#N

Objects.Name: two-handed dwarven axe
Objects.Description: A two-handed dwarven axe is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can do a lot more damage if you swing at something with your
entire body weight behind the swing.  This axe is a perfect example of that
truism.

Objects.Name: helmet mininghelmet
Objects.Description: A sturdy, slightly dented helmet lies on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As every dwarf knows, "them rockies hurt!", especially when they hit you on
the head. To prevent this, every dwarven miner has to wear this helmet,
protecting them from the small pebbles that falls from the cavern roof. It
does not, however, protect them from the more heavy rocks. (or maces, clubs,
hammers and other tools of violence).

Objects.Name: gold dwarven wedding golden ring
Objects.Description: Gwandolyn must be washing dishes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This golden ring represents very fine work of the dwarves.  On it you see
engraved the emblem of King Kwathoum, the current Dwarf King. Kwathoum gave it
to Gwandolyn when they married, long dwarfyears ago.

Objects.Name: gloves dwarven mining
Objects.Description: A pair of thick dwarven gloves are sturdy yet flexible.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These gloves are made from yak hide tanned and beaten soft as a baby human's
skin.  They are tough enough to withstand the constant use by the miners, and
protect the dwarves' skin.

Objects.Name: gold lump nugget
Objects.Description: A very large nugget of gold sits on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Perhaps if you took this to a metallurgist, he might tell you if it was
actually worth anything.  Or perhaps you could simply try to sell it.

Objects.Name: pick miningpick
Objects.Description: Hey ho, what do you know?  It sure looks like a mining pick!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Heyho, heyho, we off to work we go... if you're gonna go mining, better have a
pick that can mine. And this one can. Thats why the dwarves use it, after all.

Objects.Name: armband mark Mostal
Objects.Description: The Mark of the Dwarven Mining God Mostal depicts a lump of coal.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Dwarf miners worship Mostal, and depend upon him to protect him from the
many very real dangers of life beneath the crust of the earth.  He is seen in
Dwarven art (what there is of it) as dark as the earth itself, with a beard
full and thick, eyes of deepest blue, and a thick, short body.  His mark
resembles one of the gifts of the earth, a lump of coal.

Objects.Name: key mine
Objects.Description: There is a key to the mines lying here.

Objects.Name: key bright gold
Objects.Description: There is a bright golden key lying here.

Objects.Name: hammer dwarven
Objects.Description: There is a dwarven hammer lying here.

Objects.Name: plate dwarven mail
Objects.Description: There is dwarven plate mail lying here.

Objects.Name: stick
Objects.Description: There is a long, black stick lying here.

Objects.Name: stick
Objects.Description: There is a long, black stick here.

Objects.Name: club
Objects.Description: There is a dwarven club lying here.

Objects.Name: two-handed dwarven axe
Objects.Description: A two-handed dwarven axe is here.

Objects.Name: helmet
Objects.Description: A dwarven helmet is here.

Objects.Name: gold ring
Objects.Description: A golden dwarven ring is lying here.

Objects.Name: gloves
Objects.Description: A pair of thick dwarven gloves lay here.

Objects.Name: coal
Objects.Description: There is a chunk of coal here.

Objects.Name: pick
Objects.Description: There is a mining pick here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks almost blessed!

Objects.Name: scroll recall
Objects.Description: A scroll of recall lies here.

Objects.Name: beer barrel
Objects.Description: A beer barrel has been left here.

Objects.Name: firebreather bottle
Objects.Description: A firebreather has been left here.

Objects.Name: bread
Objects.Description: A loaf of bread has been left here.

Objects.Name: danish pastry
Objects.Description: A nice looking delicious danish pastry has been placed here.

Objects.Name: sword long
Objects.Description: A long sword has been left here.

Objects.Name: lantern
Objects.Description: A brass lantern is here.

Objects.Name: scroll clan crecall
Objects.Description: A scroll has carelessly been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The scroll has written a formulae of 'Clan Recall' upon it.

Objects.Name: spear crude metal guard
Objects.Description: A long pointy metal spear is stuck into the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dwarven mill guards' equipment is a bit crude in all its parts,
but the efficiency is still pretty good due to excellent craftsmanship of
the blacksmiths working next to the mill and of course on the guards own
skills. The spear is solid and heavy with one of its ends sharp and
pointy. Not a pretty weapon but it has proven well in previous battles.

Objects.Name: harness crude metal guard
Objects.ShortDescription: a harness of a dwarven mill guard
Objects.Description: A crude harness suitable for a huge ice chest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This harness tells you something about the compactness of the mill
guards and a whole lot more about the stamina. They must wear this all
day long. In the middle of what should be the chest the mill emblema is
clearly visible and remarkably spotless.

The mill emblema consist of a nice white smiths handycraft where two
crossed torches also cross a central sledgehammer. This is to
symbolise the fire and the craftmanship needed to produce the iron.
A powerful symbol, greet it with respect and a open heart.

Objects.Name: boots guard crude metal
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of crude metal boots
Objects.Description: The heavy metal boots of a mill guard stands here without owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Phew!!! The stench is incredible, guess these combat boots can be
used in more than one way to kill an enemy. You restrict yourself from
further investigation just to be on the safe side.

Another way would perhaps be to tapdance them to death, yet another
to drown them in the produced sweat. Use your imagination.

Objects.Name: helm crude metal guard pike
Objects.Description: A small pot with a pike on can not lie still on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Basically a crude metal pot with a very pointy tip on top of it. Must
be something the dwarfs made up to compensate for the minotaur ability to
do serious damage with a head-first charge into the enemy. On the other
hand minotaurs are not really well known for their great wits so one can
wonder why the dwarves wanted to take up on this habit.

Objects.Name: hammer crude metal guard 7 foot
Objects.Description: A crude hammer was dropped because it was not worth a single dime...

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The hammer is more like a sledge or a pickaxe than something else. A
long pole with a crude and guaranteed painmaking metal block in the end.
Guess the length gives a good swing and the clog of metal a more than
brutal impact in the hands of a skilled user.

Objects.Name: brush heavy
Objects.Description: A bit heavy brush useful for cleaning purposed awaits your firm grip.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A standard home-made brush with short branches tied together at the
end of a long (dwarf-size) wooden stick. Perfect for that dirty porch or
mill floor. No wonder you have never seen one before. Look around you!
The place is a mess. START CLEANING!!!

Objects.Name: hairpin romeobj
Objects.Description: A beautifully jeweled hairpin is begging to be stolen.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Diamonds and sapphires alternate on this lovely, large hairpin, meant to
skewer some wealthy woman's hair to her lovely head.
^
